decisions.reason: The inertial sensor module sits close to the core building-block system and was given its own page in 2024, so visible commitment is growing and sunk design and inventory costs favour keeping it.
The industrial AC voltage input module has had its own page in both years and supports the firm's announced industrial automation direction, so management will persist with it.
The relay module is only mentioned on the website, but it fits the modular platform and costs little to keep, so dropping it would mean writing off design work without much gain.
The LED control module launched only in 2024, so weak results can still be blamed on its recent start, and the firm will keep it within its broad modular range.
The wallbox remote access service is central to the announced expansion of charging and energy management, so the firm is strongly committed to it regardless of early results.
